latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: AI Voiceover For allows users to easily add natural AI voiceovers to their videos in English.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB; AI automatically generates professional-sounding narration within 30–60 seconds.
- Seamless onboarding: secure API token setup is managed automatically, with free trial credits available.
- Supports straightforward user commands for uploading, editing, checking credits, and exporting final videos.
- Optimized for content creators, marketers, and educators seeking quick, high-quality video narration without manual recording or editing software.
